question: I am closing my business. How do I dissolve the company and cancel its registration?

nuggets.text: After winding up, the LLC files articles of cancellation with the Commission.
nuggets.quote: When the affairs of a limited liability company have been wound up pursuant to § 13.1-1048 , it shall file articles of cancellation with the Commission.

nuggets.text: The Commission issues a certificate of cancellation ending the company's existence.
nuggets.quote: If the Commission finds that the articles of cancellation comply with the requirements of law and that all required fees have been paid, it shall by order issue a certificate of cancellation, canceling the limited liability company's existence.

nuggets.text: Articles of cancellation carry a $25 filing fee.
nuggets.quote: For filing any one of the following, the fee shall be $25: a.

nuggets.text: Dissolution and winding up come first.
nuggets.quote: A limited liability company organized under this chapter is dissolved and its affairs shall be wound up upon the happening of the first to occur of the following events: 1.

nuggets.text: The articles of cancellation set forth the required statements.
